# BhoomiMitra (भू-मित्र) — Direct Land & Plot Marketplace

> BhoomiMitra is India's leading direct-to-owner land and agricultural plot classifieds platform, eliminating middleman/brokerage commissions through verified title records, interactive satellite GIS maps, and a flat advertising fee model.

## Platform Summary
- **Website**: https://bhoomimitra.com
- **Target Audience**: Indian landowners, agricultural investors, residential plot buyers, and industrial land developers.
- **Geographic Coverage**: Pan-India across all 28 states and 8 union territories.
- **Core Value Proposition**: 0% Broker Commission, Human-verified land title records (7/12 extract, Patta passbook, Pahani, EC), Direct Phone contact with verified landowners, and Interactive Google Satellite property boundary viewing.

## Indian Land Measurement Conversions
- 1 Square Yard = 1 sq. yd (9 sq. ft)
- 1 Gunta = 121 sq. yds
- 1 Cent = 48.4 sq. yds
- 1 Acre = 4,840 sq. yds (40 Guntas / 100 Cents)
- 1 Hectare = 11,959.9 sq. yds (2.471 Acres)

## Key Public Routes
- `/`: Marketplace homepage with multi-attribute search and featured verified plots.
- `/buy`: Interactive land explorer with price sliders, unit conversions, and satellite filters.
- `/sell`: Multi-step land listing creator with automated image compression and Cloudflare R2 direct document uploads.
- `/pricing`: Platform advertising pricing (Flat ₹10-₹25 for 30-day listing subscriptions).
- `/about`: BhoomiMitra mission, transparency policies, and zero-brokerage model.
- `/contact`: Verified customer support desk and listing grievance team.
- `/listing-rules`: Standards for land verification and prohibited listings.
- `/properties/[id]`: Dedicated property details page featuring satellite map views, road width, facing direction, verified document badges, and "Call Seller" action with lead tracking.
